les_forces_de_votre_theme_representent_l: The strengths of your natal chart represent the qualities you can naturally rely on. They do not all express themselves in the same way, but together they compose your personal potential.
chaque_planete_decrit_une_fonction_inter: Each planet describes a different inner function. Its sign reveals the qualities that support its expression and how this energy can become a resource in your journey.
certaines_qualites_se_developpent_avec_l: Some qualities develop with experience, maturity, and conscious choices. They can become powerful supports in your relationships, projects, and personal growth.
votre_veritable_puissance_ne_repose_pas_: Your true power does not rest on a single quality. It emerges when your different resources collaborate: sensitivity supports action, reflection illuminates decisions, and perseverance allows your ideas to become concrete.
reconnaissez_les_qualites_que_vous_utili: • Acknowledge the qualities you already use naturally, even if they seem ordinary to you.
observez_les_situations_dans_lesquelles_: • Observe the situations in which you feel most confident, effective, or aligned.
appuyez_vous_sur_vos_forces_dominantes_p: • Rely on your dominant strengths to develop the qualities that require more time or practice.
evitez_de_transformer_une_qualite_en_exi: • Avoid turning a quality into a permanent requirement. A strength remains more constructive when it stays flexible and conscious.
